interpretation: B retains the known initial-parent gain while C adds no material defensible benefit under this budget. The confirmed bottleneck remains concentrated at the first admission decision for this configuration; do not adopt all-parent scoring.
limitations: This is one frozen Storm sparse-0010 parent/seed and Max10, beam-2, 24-coordinate-polish configuration.
The 16-descendant budget is intentionally bounded; no 5/15/30/60-second horizon is imputed when a run ends earlier.
The frozen reference selector is used as the admission signal and as a deterministic tie-break; no full-polish outcome or oracle label enters ranking.
